_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Contractor's Maintenance Program Plan
summary: The Contractor's Maintenance Program Plan describes in detail how the contractor intends to maintain equipment and other resources provided as part of the contract, including format and content preparation instructions for the data product.
use_relationship:
The Contractor's Maintenance Program Plan describes in detail how the contractor intends to maintain equipment and other resources provided as part of the contract.
This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
Reference documents cited in this DID shall be provided as Government Furnished Information (GFI) in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Contractor's Maintenance Program Plan shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Contractor's Maintenance Program Plan shall include the following sections:

children.title: Section 1.0 Introduction.
children.content: This section shall contain the following:

children.title: Purpose and Scope.
children.content: This section shall state the purpose, scope, and general applicability of the Maintenance program.

children.title: Maintenance Program Summary.
children.content: This section shall describe the program's plan major features and objectives, and provide a concise summary of the contractor's approach to accomplish maintenance.

children.title: Section 2.0
children.content:
This section shall identify applicable Operations and Maintenance (O&M) standards and specifications.
It shall also list those specifications, standards, manuals, and other documents applicable to the maintenance effort by title, document number, issuing authority, and date of issue.

children.title: Section 3.0 Detailed maintenance concept.
children.content: This section shall specify in detail the contractor's procedures for the following:

children.title: Use of the Integrated Enterprise Management System (IEMS).
Description and definitions of maintenance work types.
Development and use of detailed preventive maintenance procedure.
Section 4.0 Maintenance Organization.
children.content: This section shall identify the contractor's organization for maintenance. It shall include the following:

children.title: Relationships among the contractor maintenance organization and Operations, Supply and Purchasing, Logistics, Quality Assurance, and Engineering groups.
Responsibilities and authority for maintenance of all participating groups and organizations.
Identification of contractor maintenance organization which enables prioritization, coordination, and status management of all maintenance actions.
Policies and directives relating to maintenance.
Section 5.0 Maintenance Status Accounting.
children.content: This section shall contain the contractor's procedures for collecting, recording, processing, analyzing, and maintaining data necessary for maintenance status accounting reports. Identify established metrics to monitor in support of maintenance objectives. It shall include format and data elements used for Maintenance Status accounting records and reports.

children.title: Section 6.0 Test Measurement and Diagnostic Equipment (TMDE).
children.content: This section shall contain the procedures used for test equipment calibration and use. It shall also identify the proper use of TMDE.

children.title: Section 7.0 The Maintenance Plan/Flow Chart.
children.content: This section shall include a flow chart identifying all levels of maintenance needed and address all systems listed in Annex 2 (Systems and Equipment Description) through 4 (Site Maps, Drawings and Geographic Data) in the contract.
